body: An instruction-tuned text embedding model for multilingual retrieval and semantic similarity.
plain_description: **Turn text into useful signals for search and matching.** Use this multilingual embedding model to find relevant passages, compare sentence meaning, and support text classification. It handles long inputs up to 32K tokens.
technical_description: A 7B multilingual text embedding model in Alibaba-NLP’s GTE family, based on Qwen2-7B. It produces 3,584-dimensional embeddings and supports inputs up to 32K tokens. The README demonstrates query and document embeddings with Sentence Transformers or Transformers and documents retrieval, similarity, classification, clustering, and reranking evaluations. Fine-tuning is described using the third-party SWIFT framework.
title: gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct
